revised.test_every_reporting_oracle_declares_wha: IDENTITIES is now mandatory for every reporting oracle, so the test asserts it instead of describing the exemption.
revised.test_registrations_survive_distributed_c: extended to carry the per-field verification basis across the xdist boundary, which the controller was dropping.
revised._merge: merges the basis mapping the workers now ship alongside registrations and covered fields.
revised.pytest_sessionfinish: ships the basis mapping to the controller.
revised.pytest_testnodedown: passes the shipped basis mapping into _merge.
revised.RustSource: no longer carries a hand-written field list; the credit is derived from the file.
revised.rust_covered_fields: derives the credit by intersecting what each file mentions with the mechanism's own fields.
revised.RUST_SOURCES: the hand-transcribed per-source field lists were deleted, 17 of 51 of which named a field absent from the file crediting it.
revised.CIRCULARITY: two unprobed comparisons in the reconstruction oracle were probed and recorded.
revised.Disagreement: the coordinates oracle now refuses an identity absent from its IDENTITIES.
revised.disagreements: the projection oracle's orientation detail moved out of the identity string, which made it raise on a flipped record.
revised._projection_case: gained the flipped-record case that exposed the crash.
revised._coverage_line: can now cover every field of a mechanism, so the registration row reaches `verified` in the test.

test_recorded_fields_are_owned_by_the_me.why: the guard moved from the hand-written table to the derivation that replaced it; the old name read as if a recorded list were still being checked.
